title: packet-btle: added support of LL_CS_CAPABILITIES_REQ/RSP and LL_CS_CONFIG_REQ packets
description:
- minor fixes related to BLE 6.0 packets
- added dissection of three types of Bluetooth Low Energy packets related to Channel Sounding feature: LL_CS_CAPABILITIES_REQ/LL_CS_CAPABILITIES_RSP/LL_CS_CONFIG_REQ packets

commits_data.title: packet-btle: LL_CS_CONFIG_REQ dissection
commits_data.message:
packet-btle: LL_CS_CONFIG_REQ dissection

added dissection of LL_CS_CONFIG_REQ packet according to
Bluetooth Core Specification 6.0, Vol. 6, Part B,
2.4.2.45 LL_CS_CONFIG_REQ

Signed-off-by: Ivan Iushkov <ivan.iushkov@nordicsemi.no>

commits_data.title: packet-btle: LL_CS_CAPABILITIES_REQ/RSP dissection
commits_data.message:
packet-btle: LL_CS_CAPABILITIES_REQ/RSP dissection

added dissection of LL_CS_CAPABILITIES_REQ and
LL_CS_CAPABILITIES_RSP packets content in accordance
to Bluetooth Core Specification 6.0, Vol. 6, Part B,
2.4.2.44 LL_CS_CAPABILITIES_REQ and LL_CS_CAPABILITIES_RSP

Signed-off-by: Ivan Iushkov <ivan.iushkov@nordicsemi.no>

commits_data.title: packet-btle: change version of supported BLE Spec
commits_data.message:
packet-btle: change version of supported BLE Spec

Wireshark supports BLE packets defined in
Bluetooth Core Specification 6.0 so the version
in GUI can be changed to 6.0

Signed-off-by: Ivan Iushkov <ivan.iushkov@nordicsemi.no>

commits_data.title: packet-btle: rename Bluetooth 6.0 LLCP packets
commits_data.message:
packet-btle: rename Bluetooth 6.0 LLCP packets

removed LL_CTRL_OPCODE_ prefixes from control_opcode_vals[].strptr
table to align packet names with Bluetooth Core Specification
and to improve readability of packets in Wireshark GUI

Signed-off-by: Ivan Iushkov <ivan.iushkov@nordicsemi.no>

commits_data.title: packet-btle: fixed typo in the packet name LL_CS_SEC_REQ
commits_data.message:
packet-btle: fixed typo in the packet name LL_CS_SEC_REQ

renamed LL_CTRL_OPCODE_LL_CS_SEQ_REQ to
LL_CTRL_OPCODE_LL_CS_SEC_REQ.
The packet name refers to Channel Sounding Security
Request

Signed-off-by: Ivan Iushkov <ivan.iushkov@nordicsemi.no>
